children: The annual inflation rate in Albania fell to 3.2% in August 2026 from 3.4% in the previous month.

Prices eased for food and non-alcoholic beverages (2.8% vs 3.5% in July), housing & utilities (3.7% vs 4.1%), furnishings & household equipment (2.8% vs 3.3%), miscellaneous goods & services (2.8% vs 3.1%), alcoholic beverages & tobacco (2.4% vs 3%), health (1.8% vs 1.9%), recreation & culture (5.4% vs 6%), and restaurants & hotels (2.3% vs 2.7%).
Also, cost fell further for clothing & footwear (-3.2% vs -1.8%) and communications (-1% vs -0.9%).
On the other hand, prices accelerated for transport (12% vs 8%).
On a monthly basis, consumer prices went up 0.1%, after a 0.2% gain in July.

title: Albania Inflation Eases in August
